title: Add Home Tdarr Matrix Progress Bar
summary: Add a shared progress-bar indicator to the Home Tdarr Matrix panel.
reason: The Home panel showed the live matrix counts as text, but a long 100 percent matrix run needs a faster visual progress read.
behavior_before: Home showed Tdarr Matrix status and count text but no progress bar.
behavior_after: Home renders a determinate Tdarr Matrix Samples progress bar from worker-result count and selected count, using the existing WebView progress-bar renderer. The panel remains read-only and only links to Diagnostics.
